findings.description: The reference-word check lowercases nothing: the regex only matches lowercase letters, so a capitalized follow-up like "Also, what about the stall speed?" or "It is..." never matches REFERENCE_WORDS.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a weak follow-up whose reference word is capitalized, such as a question starting with "It", "That", "Also" or "Same". The findall on [a-z']+ yields "lso" or "t" instead of the word, so refers_to_previous_turn returns False and the retry with the prior question is skipped. Impact: the model answers from the weak retrieval alone and abstains, where the intended follow-up retry would have found context.
